test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the 2011 Census, arrange the following languages in descending order of Speakers strength: Marathi, Hindi, Maithili.
solution:
The correct answer is** __Hindi, Marathi, Maithili__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 2011 census recorded **31 individual languages** as having more than 1 million native speakers (0.1% of the total population).</
